title: B · One presenter, three short lessons
lesson: One presenter across three takes. Between q1 and q2 a cut to b-roll; between q2 and q3 a bridge generated from first and last frame, so the join cannot be seen. You design the person once, write three questions, and keep everything else identical.

frames.task: Design the presenter: two or three candidates from a short description, or a photo the designer brings. They pick.

slots.caption: 1 · Was ist Ihnen bei Ihren Geldanlagen gerade am wichtigsten?
slots.task: Write your first question in German, 14 words at most. Same start frame, same scene words as q2 and q3.
The b-roll between q1 and q2, no face: brief it with the shot card. This one is a plain cut; the next join is a bridge.

slots.caption: 2 · Was hat sich für Sie verändert?
slots.task: Your second question. Only the line changes from q1.

slots.purpose: Bridge: from where q2 is cut to where q3 begins
slots.task: Join q2 and q3 with no visible cut. Extract the two frames (where q2 is cut in the edit, where q3 begins), then brief ONE small natural action between them: a sip of water, a glance at notes. Compare it with the hard cut between q1 and q2.

slots.caption: 3 · Woran merken Sie, dass es passt?
slots.task: Your third question. Only the line changes; compare the three takes for consistency.

note: The prompts in prompts/ are worked examples and the source of the reserve clips, not the starting point: the designer briefs each slot from its task.
